problem: Helps Instagram creators and small brands plan, write and check posts, Reels, captions, comments and DMs using Claude. It also removes the telltale 'AI-sounding' style from drafts.

stack.backend: Python scripts (no dependencies, no network) that run locally, plus Markdown SKILL.md instruction files
stack.database: — (uses local JSON files such as hooks.json and rubric.json, and a voice.md style file)
stack.ai: Claude skills for Claude Code (13 slash commands); a SKILL.md can also be pasted into any chat
stack.deploy: Claude Code plugin via marketplace, or copy the skill folders into ~/.claude/skills

whatsNew: Instead of only prompting the model, it ships small Python tools that actually run: they score hooks against 26 formulas, time scripts, and lint text. A 'humanizer' strips em dashes and hidden watermark characters and scores the result against a five-check panel.
